method_notes.nhtsa_source: NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings bulk data (Safercar_data.csv), columns MAKE, MODEL, MODEL_YR, BODY_STYLE, DRIVE_TRAIN, MIN_GROSS_WEIGHT, MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT, CURB_WEIGHT, STATIC_STABI_FACTOR; quotes are the relevant cells of the matching row
method_notes.units: lengths in m, masses in kg; 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg, 1 in = 0.0254 m, 1 ft = 0.3048 m, 1 lb-ft = 1.3558179 N·m, 1 hp = 0.7457 kW
method_notes.turning_circle: value is a turning DIAMETER in m
method_notes.status_key: value null + note starting 'not found' = searched and not found; note starting 'estimate' = intentionally left for the game's rule of thumb; range_kg = only a range was published
method_notes.blocked_sources: media.gm.com / media.chevrolet.com (redirect to newsroom root), media.gm.ca (403), media.ford.com spec PDFs (403 or redirect), Toyota US product-information PDF (403), auto123 (404), caranddriver.com, motortrend.com and web.archive.org (fetch tool refuses), edmunds, jdpower, carcostcanada, thecarconnection (403)

small.model: 2019 Honda Civic Sedan LX, 2.0 L, CVT (US spec)

curb_mass_kg.note: converted from lb (CVT figure). Honda Canada lists LX CVT at 1270 kg: https://hondanews.ca/en-CA/releases/release-4f32a27ba2ad7509bfa642e1160211d9-2019-civic-4d-specs

gvwr_kg.note: Honda spec page lists no GVWR; NHTSA ratings data gives a 3737-3902 lb gross-weight range for the 2019 Civic 4-door without mapping it to trims, so no single value is given

cg_height_m.note: computed: cg_height = mean(track_front, track_rear) / (2 x SSF), using the tracks in this file (NHTSA's own measured track for its test vehicle is not in the CSV). SSF 1.48.

yaw_inertia_kgm2.note: estimate: NHTSA measured inertial data (Heydinger et al., SAE 1999-01-1336, 'data through November 1998', 496 entries) covers vehicles measured up to 1998 only, so it has no entry for this generation; the full table is not openly published (TRID record says copies come from NHTSA). No other published yaw inertia found. Left null for the game's rule of thumb.

rolling_radius_m.note: computed from 215/55R16: 16 in / 2 + 215 mm x 0.55; unloaded nominal radius, not a measured loaded or rolling radius

steering_ratio.note: Honda lists 'Variable Ratio Electric Power-Assisted Rack-and-Pinion Steering'; 10.94 is Honda's single published figure

transmission.quote: Continuously Variable Transmission (M-CVT): Available [LX]; 6-Speed Manual Transmission (6MT): standard [LX]
